input_fields.name: error_log
input_fields.description: Raw error records with timestamps/sequence and source identity.

input_fields.name: stage_events
input_fields.description: Run-stage events including load, execution, assertions, and terminal state.

input_fields.name: observed_state
input_fields.description: Run/document state at or immediately before the first failure.

result_fields.name: earliest_failure
result_fields.description: First error, stage, source location, time/sequence, run reference, and state snapshot.

result_fields.name: chronology_status
result_fields.description: One of ordered, partial, conflicting, or needs_manual_review.

procedure: Normalize errors and stage events by reliable time/sequence while retaining source references and run_ref.
Reject or partition records with mixed run_ref; never merge events from different runs.
Choose the earliest causally supported failure, not merely the last dialog or truncated cascade line.
Snapshot stage, source location, run_ref, and state; set needs_manual_review when order/causality cannot be established.
rejection_rules: Reject missing original error, stage, run association, or mixed-run records.
Fail closed when timestamps/sequence are contradictory; do not pick a first event by display order.
Do not classify, repair, rerun, or delete artifacts here.
